tier_should.rationale: Timely quantification of EID vaccine portfolio economics; credible calibration and sensitivity analysis. Contribution is policy-relevant but methodologically incremental and assumption-heavy. Strong fit for health economics/operations/health-policy outlets rather than general-interest A-journals.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authorship and NBER visibility improve prospects. Cross-disciplinary scope fits Management Science, Vaccine, or Health Affairs. Assumption-heavy simulations limit A-journal appeal; likely placement in strong field journal.
